runs.text: A closure is a function that carries with it the values it needs.
Each week, the kiosk launches a discount campaign whose
percentage is read at the start
of the previous lesson needs a function that receives a single value, the price.
How is that function created if the percentage is not known when the program is written?
Write in words which function would be needed for 10 % and which for 20 %. What do they have in common?
take a tenth off the price
take a fifth off the price
. Both do the same with a different number. That number is not known when the program is written: the function has to be made when it is read.

entries.text: What goes in and what comes out?
The percentage and the prices go in; the discounted prices come out.
, with a function that does not exist yet.
Which part is calculation and which part touches the world?
Asking for the percentage touches the world; making the function and applying it is calculation.

blocks.description: First step: the factory CrearDescuento receives 20 and gives back a function that carries the 20 in its backpack. Second step: the function receives the price 50, uses the 20 from the backpack and gives back 40.

caption.text: The factory keeps the percentage in the backpack of the function it gives back; the function uses it each time it is called.
